title: Keto Mediterranean Pancake Cakes
description: A rich and comforting keto breakfast dish that combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the warmth of pancakes.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, combine the cauliflower flour, ricotta cheese, feta cheese, parsley, oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Mix well until a dough forms.
Using a cookie scoop or spoon, drop the dough onto the prepared baking sheet, about 1/4 cupfuls.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cakes are golden brown and set.
While the cakes are baking, heat the tapenade in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the cakes are done, remove them from the oven and brush with the tapenade.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley and oregano if desired.
